toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb ('Die San is ...' / 'hulle woon ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A correct AWS 2017 comma that changes nothing in meaning.

toegepas.voor: klanke wat min ander tale het
toegepas.na: klanke wat in min ander tale voorkom
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written the relative clause can be read as 'sounds that have few other languages'; this removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'klanke wat min ander tale het' lets a reader take 'wat' as the subject, so the sounds seem to 'have' languages.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal removes the stumble and still says the sounds occur in few other languages; the protected sentence in the glossary is untouched.

toegepas.voor: San-vroue maak daardie krale vandag nog.
toegepas.na: San-vroue maak vandag nog sulke krale.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daardie' points to the same old beads; 'sulke' means beads of that kind, and the adverb before the object is the natural order.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie krale' points to the very beads just described, but women today make beads of that kind, not the same old ones.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sulke' says exactly what is meant, and 'maak vandag nog sulke krale' is the natural Afrikaans order.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The fixed expression is 'van hand tot hand gaan'; objects do not 'trek'.
toegepas.fout: The fixed expression is 'van hand tot hand gaan'; 'getrek' breaks it and is unnatural for objects.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restores the fixed expression; the distance and the hand-to-hand movement stay exactly the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bymekaarkom' is a separable compound verb and is written as one word when it stands together at the end of a subordinate clause.
toegepas.fout: The separable verb 'bymekaarkom' is written as one word when its parts stand together at the end of the clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling correction with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: Sang is deel van hoe hulle stories en kennis aan mekaar oordra
toegepas.na: Sang is een van die maniere waarop hulle stories en kennis aan mekaar oordra
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'deel van hoe' is a calque of 'part of how'; the Afrikaans construction keeps the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'deel van hoe hulle ... oordra' is a calque of English 'part of how'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'een van die maniere waarop' is the natural Afrikaans construction and keeps the same claim about singing as a means of passing things on.

toegepas.voor: 'n bron wat ons van die San se lewe vertel
toegepas.na: 'n bron wat vir ons van die San se lewe vertel
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'vir', 'wat ons' can be read as 'that we tell', so the relative clause is ambiguous.
toegepas.fout: ''n bron wat ons ... vertel' can be read as 'a source that we tell'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'vir' removes the misreading; in both versions the source tells us, so the direction is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'string' is unnatural for people moving one behind the other; 'ry' is the ordinary word.
toegepas.fout: 'in 'n string' is an unnatural, English-sounding word for people dancing one behind the other.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ry' is the plain word for the same formation; the protected 'Meestal dans die mans' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: Jy praat elke dag en jy sien
toegepas.na: Jy praat elke dag, en jy sien
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses each with its own subject and verb ('Jy praat ...' / 'jy sien ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A correct AWS 2017 comma with no change in meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence is in the past tense ('het gewys'), and 'verbonde aan' is the correct adjectival form for being connected to someone.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'aan wie jy verbind is' is correct Afrikaans with a generic 'jy', and the switch to 'was' only shifts tense while hinting the bond has ended.

laat_vaar.voor: om die vuur, sing en klap
laat_vaar.na: om die vuur, sing en klap hande
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'klap' on its own can mean to slap; 'hande klap' says clearly what the women do.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'sing en klap' is ordinary Afrikaans for singing and clapping, and the context of song and dance rules out 'slap'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'daarby gekom' as two words reads as 'got there'; 'bygekom' is the natural verb for being added.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'het net daarby gekom' reads naturally as 'were added to them', while 'bygekom' drops the reference to the five ways and can be read as 'came round'.

na_skrywer.voor: Om 'n boodskap by iemand anders uit te kry.
na_skrywer.na: Om 'n boodskap aan iemand anders oor te dra.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'by iemand uitkry' is colloquial and calques 'get across'; 'aan iemand oordra' is the standard expression for a definition.
na_skrywer.fout: 'iets by iemand uitkry' ordinarily means getting something out of someone, which reverses the direction a definition of communication needs.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real fault in a glossary definition, which only the writer may reword.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'een' stresses the number one; the indefinite article is the natural form here.
na_skrywer.fout: 'sonder een vaste huis' stresses the number one and reads slightly unnaturally; the article or another wording may be meant.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is fair, but rewording a glossary definition belongs to the writer, who can judge whether 'een' was deliberate.
